subject: YOU DOUBLE-BILLED MY CREDIT CARD AND LOCKED MY ACCOUNT!! FIX THIS NOW!!
body: THIS IS RIDICULOUS AND OUTRAGEOUS! You charged my company card $600 TWICE this morning, causing our bank to flag our card for fraud and freeze our corporate account! And now when my staff tries to log in, your login page says ACCOUNT SUSPENDED! Unfreeze our workspace and refund the duplicate $600 IMMEDIATELY or I will report FlowBoard to the FTC and post on Twitter/LinkedIn!
